summary.text: XL-BYGG MYRE AS is a private limited company registered in Myre, founded 2018-09-10. XL-BYGG MYRE AS sells building materials, interior products and food products in retail, and may also carry out building construction as a contractor, along with other business activities that naturally fall together with these. Its main industry code is 47.520: retail sale of hardware, building materials, paints and glass. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 60 917 601 NOK and the annual result was -1 022 683 NOK; operating income was up from 51 782 858 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -2 491 336 NOK in 2024 to -1 022 683 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 3 735 239 NOK in 2024 to 2 712 556 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 15 on 2026-01-13 to 19 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
